answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can gate every state transition on a per-identity nonce verified against an epoch entropy beacon, so replaying cloned agents fails because each fork must wait for a distinct beacon slot before its transitions attest. To scale a sybil fleet, an attacker must burn fresh nonces for every duplicate identity, and the beacon delay serializes their replays into slow, costly queues while honest agents proceed.
